scientific_choices.rationale: Paper sections 3.2/3.3 describe segmentation, connected regions and crop recognition.
Reuse the checksum-locked official PARSeq runtime/checkpoint adapter; exact paper PARSeq-S artifact remains unresolved.
Evaluate the newly trained U-Net and crop OCR alone, without changing the complete contextual pipeline or claiming Table 5 reproduction.

User requests symbol-free word F1. Keep Unicode letters/numbers after casefold; one-to-one bbox IoU>=0.5 plus exact normalized text. Empty normalized outputs never match and all original care/prediction denominators remain.

Transfer frozen letterbox512/native256, 8-connected component extrema, no area/top-ten limit and pad0; invert letterbox to original RGB. GT boxes use inclusive raster extrema plus one, clamped to RGB bounds. This is not official polygon Hmean.
Unload segmentation before PARSeq; FP32, segmentation batch1 and OCR batch32. Record separate allocated/reserved GPU peaks; no end-to-end latency claim.
